skills.name: Funnel analysis

skills.name: Retention analysis

skills.name: Segmentation

signals: Segments have stable definitions and sufficient sample sizes.

skills.name: Forecasting

skills.name: Dashboard design

skills.name: Data storytelling

signals: A recommendation distinguishes observed facts from assumptions.

skills.name: Stakeholder discovery

skills.name: Event validation

skills.name: Attribution analysis

signals: The report shows how conclusions vary with model assumptions.

skills.name: Unit economics

skills.name: Pricing analysis

signals: An analysis separates observed revenue changes from inferred price effects.

skills.name: Requirements modeling

signals: Requirements link to testable acceptance criteria and dependencies.

skills.name: Process modeling

signals: The model exposes handoffs, exceptions and responsibility gaps.

skills.name: System context modeling

skills.name: Interface specification

signals: Examples cover success, validation failure and unavailable dependencies.

skills.name: Domain glossary

skills.name: Data mapping

skills.name: Impact analysis

signals: A change assessment links dependencies to migration and test work.

skills.name: Traceability
